name: Summer Adventure
source:
Anna, a passionate archaeologist, finds herself drawn into a dangerous conspiracy after a mysterious shipwreck. On her journey, she faces seductive cults, ancient artifacts, and erotic rituals that test not only her mind, but her body and reputation. Each artifact she uncovers reveals secrets of the past and awakens her deepest desires. Anna must use her charm, wit, and courage to outsmart the cult and unlock the power of the legendary Crystal of Temptation, risking everything for truth and pleasure.

[From Itch.io]
